description: Inventory a domain's TXT records and say what is wrong with them. Reads every TXT at the apex and labels each one by vendor or purpose (SPF, Google, Microsoft, Atlassian, Stripe and over a hundred more, grouped into categories), then reads 12 well-known names (_dmarc, _mta-sts, _smtp._tls, default._bimi, _acme-challenge, _amazonses and other provider tokens). Findings: TXT_MULTIPLE_SPF_LIKE (error: more than one v=spf1 record, RFC 7208 §4.5 permerror, so SPF fails for every message), TXT_APEX_DKIM_MISPLACED (error: a DKIM key at the apex, where no verifier looks), TXT_DUPLICATE_TOKEN (warn: the same vendor token twice, usually a stale one), TXT_LOCATIONS_INCOMPLETE (warn: some lookups failed; not evidence of absence) and TXT_NO_RECORDS (info). `verdict` is clean / warnings / misconfigured / incomplete / no_records; no grade. `analysis` carries apex[] (value, ttl, label, category), inventory (category to labels) and locations[] (name, label, status found/absent/failed, values). For a full SPF or DMARC judgement call check_spf or check_dmarc. Read-only.

domain.description: Apex domain to inspect, e.g. "google.com". No scheme, no path.
